summary: FULL BACKEND PURCHASE JOURNEY VERIFIED END-TO-END (13/13 pytest cases PASS) against the real connector on https://ap3p-fitness.com via the FastAPI trusted proxy at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://apeps-mobile-demo.preview.emergentagent.com. The reported /register-404 regression is FIXED — the /wp-json/glp/v1 namespace now registers /register (empty-body returns 400 invalid_input, bad telegram returns 400 telegram_invalid, happy-path returns 200 with a valid token and customer.approved=true, customer.telegram_username set). Full chain traversed on a brand-new customer: register -> /me -> /catalogue (12 products, in-stock items present) -> /products/177 (type=variable, 3 variations incl. variation_id=236 purchasable=true) -> /basket/validate (valid=true, subtotal_display set) -> /shipping/quote (flat_rate:1 returned) -> POST /orders (crypto/tron, order_id=257, number=257, status=pending, payment_method=apeps_crypto, total=£93.99) -> /orders/257/crypto-invoice (network=tron, token=USDT, status=awaiting_payment, amount=125.80 USDT, fiat_total=93.99, address=TDdQVni8hTxmu6sCaxYeiKoHJo91EQUJJt, payment_uri+network_label+required_confirmations+remaining_seconds all present) -> /orders list contains the new order -> /crypto/networks includes a tron/TRC20 entry. CRITICAL OBSERVATION: invoice.test_mode == false on the live upstream. This matches what the main agent flagged — the WooCommerce Apeps-crypto plugin on ap3p-fitness.com is NOT in Crypto Test Mode, which means test invoices will NOT auto-progress to paid status on-chain. If 'Crypto Test Mode' was intended for this verification run, the plugin flag needs to be flipped on the WordPress side; the proxy and connector are otherwise healthy end-to-end.

minor.issue: Observed invoice.test_mode = false on the live backend. Review request intended Crypto Test Mode; main agent explicitly asked to report this value. If Test Mode is expected, enable it in the Apeps crypto plugin settings on ap3p-fitness.com (WordPress admin), otherwise created test orders remain genuinely 'awaiting_payment' with real TRC20 USDT addresses and will not auto-progress to paid.

Response is wrapped as {"product": {...}} rather than the flat shape used by /catalogue items. Not a bug (connector-side decision) but worth noting for mobile clients — they must unwrap .product on this endpoint only.

stock_status values use underscores ('in_stock' / 'low_stock' / 'out_of_stock') rather than WooCommerce canonical ('instock' / 'outofstock'). Harmless but the mobile app must match these exact strings when filtering stock.

rca_of_issue: Previous reported bug: POST /wp-json/glp/v1/register returned 404 because the entire glp/v1 namespace registered 0 routes (fatal from a duplicate plugin copy preventing register_rest_route from running). After the user re-installed a single active copy of the updated 'GLP App Connector', the namespace now registers properly: /register responds with 200 on valid input, 400 invalid_input on empty body, and 400 telegram_invalid on bad telegram — all three paths verified in this run (not 404). The companion endpoints in the same namespace (/me, /catalogue, /products, /basket/validate, /shipping/quote, /orders, /orders/{id}/crypto-invoice, /crypto/networks) are also fully live, confirming the entire route table was re-registered on plugin re-activation.
